description: A joke module that patches cables for you: one click runs a cable from a randomly chosen output somewhere in the rack to a randomly chosen free input
notes: Click the question mark and one cable appears. The output is picked from every output in the patch, whether or not it already carries cables; the input is picked only from free ones.
With no free input anywhere in the patch, or no output anywhere, the click does nothing and nothing is reported.
The cable is added to the undo history, so one press of undo removes it.
The question mark is drawn as a plain button rather than as a module parameter, so it cannot be clicked for help.
The maker calls this one a work in progress in the plugin's README, on the grounds that cabling at random rarely gives a useful signal path.
